schema.text: How does the availability of working lifts, ramps, and step-free routes affect your ability to reach the transport stop?

options.text: I cannot reach the stop if no accessible route exists
I need assistance from another person to reach the stop
I can reach the stop, but it requires significant physical effort
I can reach the stop independently with some difficulty
I can reach the stop easily and independently

it.#How does the availability of working li: In che modo la disponibilità di ascensori funzionanti, rampe e percorsi senza gradini influisce sulla tua capacità di raggiungere la fermata?
it.#I cannot reach the stop if no accessibl: Non posso raggiungere la fermata se non esiste un percorso accessibile
it.#I need assistance from another person t: Ho bisogno dell'assistenza di un'altra persona per raggiungere la fermata
it.#I can reach the stop, but it requires s: Posso raggiungere la fermata, ma ciò richiede un notevole sforzo fisico
it.#I can reach the stop independently with: Posso raggiungere la fermata autonomamente, ma con qualche difficoltà
it.#I can reach the stop easily and indepen: Posso raggiungere la fermata facilmente e in autonomia

fr.#How does the availability of working li: Comment la présence d’ascenseurs en état de marche, de rampes et de parcours sans marches influence-t-elle votre capacité à rejoindre l’arrêt ?
fr.#I cannot reach the stop if no accessibl: Je ne peux pas atteindre l’arrêt s’il n’existe pas de parcours accessible
fr.#I need assistance from another person t: J’ai besoin de l’aide d’une autre personne pour atteindre l’arrêt
fr.#I can reach the stop, but it requires s: Je peux atteindre l’arrêt, mais cela demande un effort physique important
fr.#I can reach the stop independently with: Je peux atteindre l’arrêt seul(e), mais avec quelques difficultés
fr.#I can reach the stop easily and indepen: Je peux atteindre l’arrêt facilement et de façon autonome

de.#How does the availability of working li: Wie beeinflussen funktionierende Aufzüge, Rampen und stufenfreie Wege Ihre Möglichkeit, die Haltestelle zu erreichen?
de.#I cannot reach the stop if no accessibl: Ich kann die Haltestelle nicht erreichen, wenn es keinen barrierefreien Weg gibt
de.#I need assistance from another person t: Ich brauche Hilfe von einer anderen Person, um die Haltestelle zu erreichen
de.#I can reach the stop, but it requires s: Ich kann die Haltestelle erreichen, aber es kostet mich viel körperliche Kraft
de.#I can reach the stop independently with: Ich kann die Haltestelle selbstständig erreichen, aber nur mit einigen Schwierigkeiten
de.#I can reach the stop easily and indepen: Ich kann die Haltestelle leicht und selbstständig erreichen

tr.#How does the availability of working li: Çalışan asansörlerin, rampaların ve basamaksız güzergâhların olması durağa ulaşma becerinizi nasıl etkiler?
tr.#I cannot reach the stop if no accessibl: Erişilebilir bir güzergâh yoksa durağa ulaşamam
tr.#I need assistance from another person t: Durağa ulaşmak için başka bir kişinin yardımına ihtiyaç duyarım
tr.#I can reach the stop, but it requires s: Durağa ulaşabilirim, ancak ciddi fiziksel çaba gerektirir
tr.#I can reach the stop independently with: Durağa kendi başıma ulaşabilirim, ancak biraz zorlanırım
tr.#I can reach the stop easily and indepen: Durağa kolayca ve bağımsız olarak ulaşabilirim

fa.#How does the availability of working li: وجود آسانسور سالم، رمپ و مسیر بدون پله چه اثری بر توانایی شما برای رسیدن به ایستگاه دارد؟
fa.#I cannot reach the stop if no accessibl: اگر مسیر دسترس‌پذیر وجود نداشته باشد، نمی‌توانم به ایستگاه برسم
fa.#I need assistance from another person t: برای رسیدن به ایستگاه به کمک فرد دیگری نیاز دارم
fa.#I can reach the stop, but it requires s: می‌توانم به ایستگاه برسم، اما تلاش جسمی زیادی لازم است
fa.#I can reach the stop independently with: می‌توانم مستقل به ایستگاه برسم، اما با کمی دشواری
fa.#I can reach the stop easily and indepen: می‌توانم به‌راحتی و مستقل به ایستگاه برسم

hu.#How does the availability of working li: Hogyan befolyásolja a működő liftek, rámpák és lépcsőmentes útvonalak megléte azt, hogy el tudja-e érni a megállót?
hu.#I cannot reach the stop if no accessibl: Nem tudom elérni a megállót, ha nincs akadálymentes útvonal
hu.#I need assistance from another person t: Más személy segítségére van szükségem a megálló eléréséhez
hu.#I can reach the stop, but it requires s: El tudom érni a megállót, de ehhez jelentős fizikai erőfeszítés kell
hu.#I can reach the stop independently with: Önállóan el tudom érni a megállót, de némi nehézséggel
hu.#I can reach the stop easily and indepen: Könnyen és önállóan el tudom érni a megállót

ar.#How does the availability of working li: كيف يؤثر وجود مصاعد تعمل، ومنحدرات، وطرق من دون درجات في قدرتك على الوصول إلى المحطة؟
ar.#I cannot reach the stop if no accessibl: لا أستطيع الوصول إلى المحطة إذا لم يوجد طريق سهل الوصول
ar.#I need assistance from another person t: أحتاج إلى مساعدة شخص آخر للوصول إلى المحطة
ar.#I can reach the stop, but it requires s: أستطيع الوصول إلى المحطة، لكن ذلك يتطلب مجهودًا بدنيًا كبيرًا
ar.#I can reach the stop independently with: أستطيع الوصول إلى المحطة بمفردي، لكن مع بعض الصعوبة
ar.#I can reach the stop easily and indepen: أستطيع الوصول إلى المحطة بسهولة وبشكل مستقل
